Beat.description: LTX keyframe guide (11 §3b): the asset is encoded as a guide at `frame` with `strength`.
Beat.title: Beat

ContentAwareCaps.description: D62: whether the native extension (PhotoCraft's content-aware fill + PatchMatch) is installed, and the modes it enables.
ContentAwareCaps.title: ContentAwareCaps

DocShift.description: How far an outpaint grew the canvas to the left and top (the editor moves its layers by it).
DocShift.title: DocShift

DocumentChanged.description: Every variant carries `id`; AI results add `job_id`, `batch_id`, `added`, `group`, …; AI Select adds `selection`.
DocumentChanged.title: DocumentChanged

DocumentPreview.description:
`POST /recipes/preview` for an Edit recipe (inpaint, i2i, upscale, segment — D64): the settings that shape the run, what it needs,
the weights, ETA and VRAM fit, and the contract problems a submission would hit. The region is read at run time, not here.
DocumentPreview.title: DocumentPreview

DocumentPutReply.description: The stack as stored plus the layers / masks the server has no bytes for (B15).
DocumentPutReply.title: DocumentPutReply

Expanded.description: 17 §3b: the jobs an Expand queued — one per cell, one batch — and the candidates page they land on.
Expanded.title: Expanded

FlowGraph.description: The thin index (loom R139): where the nodes sit, the edges, the start — rebuilt from the node files when missing or disagreeing.
FlowGraph.title: FlowGraph

FlowLine.description: One line of a Dialogue node: the speaker is a profile (its mention), the text the line (loom R152: the subtitles come from these).
FlowLine.title: FlowLine

FlowNode.description:
One node of the flow, one file (loom R139). The fields a type uses: Dialogue `lines` (+ a bound shot), Shot a bound shot, Choice
`options`, Condition `cond`, Action `set`, Jump `target`, Comment `text`; Start and Hub carry a title. `shot_id` / `shot_version`
are set by binding only (loom R146: sole ownership).
FlowNode.title: FlowNode

FlowOption.description: A Choice's option: its own out-port (`opt:<id>`), an optional requirement on a variable, the variables it sets (loom R135).
FlowOption.title: FlowOption

Guide.description:
P13 ST4 (D76, 16 §8): a pass sequence (a video asset the Stage rendered — depth by default, pose as the weaker second) that LTX-2.3's
IC-LoRA Union conditions the whole clip on, from frame 0. The start frame is a Stage shot; the clip keeps lineage to both.
Guide.title: Guide

GuideUpload.description:
ST4 (16 §8): a pass rendered per frame of the range — each frame a PNG put through `PUT /blobs/{sha}`, in order — with the
per-frame COCO-18 keypoints (for the rig's scoring).
GuideUpload.title: GuideUpload

I2I.description:
Refine (10 §4): partial-denoise img2img over the visible composite, the active layer or the selection crop.
Distilled Klein cannot partial-denoise (04 §4), so the model is Klein base or dev.

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's i2i model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

I2I.title: I2I

I2V.description:
Image-to-video (11 §10; D8 Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B fp8 experts + Lightning, FLF on the same weights; D9 LTX-2.3 distilled
fp8 with keyframe beats). Sizes and frame counts snap to the model's rule in the compiler (Wan ×16 and 4n+1,
LTX ×32 and 8n+1); `graphs.i2v_params` shows the UI what will run.

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's i2v model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

I2V.title: I2V

I2VPreview.description: `POST /recipes/preview` for an i2v recipe: snapped size and frames, the preset that runs, missing weights, ETA.
I2VPreview.title: I2VPreview

Inpaint.description:
Inpaint / outpaint (10 §4, D7): Fill (Klein + LanPaint), Fill-Match (Klein ICM), Fill Hero (dev + LanPaint),
Remove (Klein ICM with the hole neutralised), Outpaint (LanPaint on an edge-padded canvas). The region comes
from the document's selection (uploaded by the editor) unless the mode is outpaint.

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's inpaint model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

Inpaint.title: Inpaint

LoraOption.description: LT1 (18 §3e): one entry of the slots' picker — what the worker would load, and why it would not.
LoraOption.title: LoraOption

Mention.description:
D73: an @mention of an album group. The client sends the id (and the name it shows); the server resolves it into references and
stamps the group's revision and the asset ids it gave — a stamped mention is not resolved again. D85: a Story profile mention names
the profile (and a version, or its current one); the server swaps the version's reference group in and stamps both — the
`asset@version` pin of loom R98.
Mention.title: Mention

MeshCaps.description: P18 (D84): the image → mesh model of this build, or why there is none.
MeshCaps.title: MeshCaps

NodeShot.description: A bind / unbind / spawn: the node and the shot it now owns (or released).
NodeShot.title: NodeShot

PassesUpload.description:
ST3 (16 §7): the passes the client rendered for one camera — each a PNG already put through `PUT /blobs/{sha}` — with the COCO-18
keypoints behind the pose pass and the mask pass's colour legend.
PassesUpload.title: PassesUpload

PoseLibrary.description: ST2: the project's saved poses — name → {preset?, joints {joint: [x, y, z] degrees}} — kept as `stages/poses.json`.
PoseLibrary.title: PoseLibrary

ProfileVersion.description:
One version of a profile (loom §3.4): its reference set is an album group (`group_id`), its expansion candidates another; `open`
is editable and expandable, `final` locks the group and the fields (a retake is a new version). `trigger` and `lora` wait for the
LoRA wave (D25).
ProfileVersion.title: ProfileVersion

ProjectFormat.description: The target the project finalises to (fixed at creation) and the working tier it defaults to (D18).
ProjectFormat.title: ProjectFormat

ReangleMethodCaps.description: P14 (D82): one angles method — the model it runs, its health, measured seconds and the moves it is good for.
ReangleMethodCaps.title: ReangleMethodCaps

RefineEdge.description: D45 Refine Edge (Photoshop's Select and Mask units). Defaults = matting.DEFAULTS, published in /capabilities.refine_edge (T8).
RefineEdge.title: RefineEdge

RefineEdgeCaps.description: D45: Refine Edge defaults (what the worker runs when a field is left out) and slider ranges [min, max, step].
RefineEdgeCaps.title: RefineEdgeCaps

RefineReply.description: D45: the refined selection is stored on the document; fetch it with GET /documents/{id}/selection.
RefineReply.title: RefineReply

Segment.description:
AI Select (10 §4, D7 masks): a mask from the visible composite becomes (part of) the document's selection.
`subject` = BiRefNet matte through the core background-removal nodes; `text` / `points` / `box` = SAM 3
(core `SAM3_Detect` on the sam3.pt checkpoint). Coordinates are document pixels; the queue scales them.

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's segment model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

Segment.title: Segment

SessionInfo.description: D67: the per-launch read-only media key (`?k=` on media URLs) and the session id.
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

ShotTake.description: Something tried for a shot version: an image (a stage-shot result, a Catalogue image) or a clip; the version picks one of each.
ShotTake.title: ShotTake

ShotVersion.description:
One version of a shot (loom R62): where it is made (a stage camera, or nothing — a clip from Animate), the frame and the one clip it
owns, every take tried; `final` fixes the clip the Flow and the Episode bind (one per version, loom R166). `stage_revision` is the
stage's revision when the frame or clip was taken — a later edit of the stage makes the version stale (advisory).
ShotVersion.title: ShotVersion

StageClipCaps.description: P13 ST4 (D76): the video model that animates a stage through its IC-LoRA — health, E11's seconds, the guide kinds, its grid.
StageClipCaps.title: StageClipCaps

StageMethodCaps.description: P13 ST3 (D78): one Stage → image method — the model it runs, its health, E10's seconds, the pass it takes and the references it allows.
StageMethodCaps.title: StageMethodCaps

StoryBeat.description: One line of the spine (loom L1 "story spine"): a Flow node is made from it by hand, never synced (loom R55).
StoryBeat.title: StoryBeat

StoryCaps.description: 17 §3b (D85): the model Expand runs on in this build, its health and warm seconds, the presets with their cell counts, the coverage vocabulary.

StoryChanged.description: 17 (D85): a Story record moved on the server (`kind`: world; later profile, shot, node) — open tabs reload it.

StoryStyle.description: One style of the world: the fragment a generation appends (17 §3a); `group_id` is a reference album (a later slice).
StoryStyle.title: StoryStyle

StoryVariable.description: A Flow variable (loom R135: bool or enum flags, nothing more in v1); conditions and actions read them by name.
StoryVariable.title: StoryVariable

model_id.description: roster id; default: the registry's t2i model (D65)
model_id.title: Model Id

T2IPreview.description: `POST /recipes/preview` for a t2i recipe: the effective parameters, the exact serialised prompt, missing weights, ETA.

TimelineExported.description: P17: an export written from the sequence document — the file inside the project and its text.

Upscale.description:
Upscale (10 §4): ESRGAN-class model on the visible composite or the active layer → a Catalogue asset at the
new size (lineage to the document's source) and, optionally, a 1× "detail" layer in the document. With `refine`
the upscaled image is re-sampled tile by tile at low strength (Klein base / dev; Ultimate-SD-Upscale pattern).

Replace the stack. The reply lists raster layers / masks the server has no bytes for, so the editor uploads
them before `/save` even when it does not consider them dirty (B15: delete · save · undo · save).

post.description: Graceful exit for the shell (06 §1): the lifespan teardown stops the queue (clean mark) and the engine.

The frames become one video asset (h264 near-lossless, `kind = video`, suite stage, `lineage_kind = stage-pass`, `params {stage_id,
camera_id, revision, pass: "<kind>-sequence", frames, fps, size, range, keypoints}`) on the stage's album page; the document records
it under the camera's passes entry (`guides[kind]`) and comes back at its new revision.

Each pass becomes an asset (`lineage_kind = stage-pass`, suite stage, `params {stage_id, camera_id, revision, pass, size}`, the
keypoints on the pose pass, the legend on the mask pass) placed on the stage's album page (made on first use, D34); the document
records them for the camera and comes back at its new revision.
The node takes the shot as its sole owner (an unbound shot, or a version of its own); 422 when another node owns it.
A new, empty shot owned by the node (the handoff to the Shots tab, loom R134).

One queued T2I job per coverage cell of the preset (× seeds), in one batch, each with the hero as reference 1 and the cell's sentence
after the stub; the results land on the version's candidates page (made on the first Expand) with `params.coverage_cell`.
A full copy of the current version (its reference set duplicated), open, now the current one.
Keep: the assets are marked keep and move onto the version's reference page; reject: marked reject, left where they are.
The version becomes final when its clip is at the project format's size (fps is conformed at export, D27); 422 says why not.
Record a take (an image or a clip) on an open version; `use` makes it the frame / clip.

put.description: Replace the document from a body based on its `revision`; every clip must be in the project and its `out` within the clip's frames.

post.description: P17: the draft render as a CPU job (no engine) — the result is a Catalogue clip with lineage to every clip on the lane.

get.description: D36: app version, checkout commit, shell build, engine pin and running engine, node pins, schema versions, paths.
